environment.description: Same application deployed on identical infrastructure but with AWS WAF v2 WebACL associated to the ALB. WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT, (2) a custom rate-based rule at priority 200 limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 with all rules in default BLOCK action and sensitivity level set to HIGH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled for sampled requests. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule condition that rejects any request where the query string length exceeds 512 bytes (returns fixed 403 response), evaluated before forwarding to target group.

config.alb: internet-facing, listener rule: query_string length > 512 bytes returns 403, then forward remaining to target group

waf_webacl.rule_1: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority 100, SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING overridden to COUNT
waf_webacl.rule_2: Rate-based rule 100 req/5min per IP, priority 200
waf_webacl.rule_3: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet priority 300, all rules BLOCK, sensitivity HIGH
